Blustin & Associates has more than 30 years of experience helping businesses and their owners work through business law related issues and obstacles by providing research, strategic planning and legal solutions. In addition, the firm has helped business owners and individuals with real estate transactions, intellectual property creation and management, and estate and succession planning by providing the necessary wills, trusts, succession planning and related documents that will allow for peace of mind and easier transitions if the need should arise.
